To boot from a USB key on a Mac Mini from around 2014, you need to follow these steps:

1. Insert the USB drive into one of the USB ports.
2. Restart your Mac Mini and immediately hold down the Power button until you hear the boot chime for the second time.
3. Release the Power button when you see the Apple logo on the screen.
4. Immediately hold down the Option (⌥) key while the Apple logo is still visible.
5. Keep holding the Option key until you see a list of available boot devices, including your USB drive.
